description: DE does not index: sections 1102, 1108 and 1110 were not amended in the 152nd or 153rd General Assembly, and the 2026 PIT-EST Instructions reprint the same schedule. TY2026 at $50,000 gives the same $2,390 as TY2025 — the printed table row 50,000-50,050, whose midpoint 50,025 gives 1,001 + 5.55% x 25,025 = 2,389.89.
